visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An adult woman with vibrant short orange hair and a young girl wearing a blue t-shirt stand in front of a colorful, cartoon-style backdrop featuring gears and industrial pipes. They gesture enthusiastically towards the camera with wide smiles and active hand movements. Both characters wear matching cream-colored crossbody bags featuring cartoon pins. (2) The camera transitions to a sequence of posters and signs within a shopping mall environment. A sign features a cartoon raccoon character named 'Mr. Hello' in an apron. The girl is seen holding a smartphone, interacting with digital elements of an exhibit. The lighting is bright and typical of an indoor retail space. (3) Close-up shots show various themed stations with cartoon characters like a hamster in a red suit and a bird wearing a postman outfit. The girl and the woman scan QR codes and point at framed comic-style photos on the wall. (4) The duo returns to the initial backdrop, pointing and gesturing excitedly towards the viewer. A rapid montage of graphic overlays showing digital coupons, gift cards, and promotional rewards follows. The video ends on a static graphic of the event logo '神探哈奇奇' against a grey brick wall background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, fast-paced electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice speaks with rapid articulation and animated intonation, greeting the audience. (2) Several short, cartoonish character voices are introduced, each accompanied by a distinct 'ding' or 'pop' sound effect used for comic timing and to emphasize points. The background music remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) The primary female voice and a younger girl's voice engage in high-energy promotional dialogue, with frequent pitch rising to indicate excitement. Whoosh transitions separate the segments of speech. (4) The music builds slightly in energy towards the end, supporting a series of rapid-fire promotional announcements delivered with clear, professional clarity. The audio concludes with a final synthesized chime and a percussive beat.
